findings: Tom Bergeron's multiphonics bibliography distinguishes composition 1982 from Leduc publication 1984 and documents numerous specified multiphonic fingerings.

Specialist and conservatory bibliographies identify unaccompanied alto saxophone, whereas the existing catalog says soprano. An Andalusian notation guide's indexed entry instead says soprano; original title-page verification is needed.
Córdoba's higher-conservatory guide describes circular breathing, playing/singing or growl, and double/triple articulation. These are source-reported requirements, not direct notation observations.
James Bunte's official site documents the 2018 album Pulse 72±: The Unaccompanied Saxophone Music of Ryo Noda, Teal Creek. Individual track metadata was not located.
